nodes.label: Heroku deployment
nodes.rationale: The Procfile release line runs migrate on every deploy so the schema stays in sync without a manual step.

nodes.label: Usage of AI log
nodes.rationale: AI used as a collaborator, not a replacement for understanding the code; specific log entries are what make the section credible to an assessor.

nodes.label: Private vulnerability reporting
nodes.rationale: Security problems reported privately via GitHub Security Advisories, not public issues, so exploits are not disclosed before a fix.

nodes.label: MoSCoW prioritisation
nodes.rationale: Stories prioritised Must/Should/Could (21/5/2) so scope is explicit; nothing in Won't have.

nodes.label: US26: Keep secrets and debug mode safe
nodes.norm_label: us26: keep secrets and debug mode safe

nodes.label: dj_database_url with ssl_require
nodes.rationale: TLS to Heroku Postgres in production without breaking local non-TLS connections.

nodes.label: DEBUG defaults to False
nodes.rationale: Forgetting to set DEBUG on Heroku fails safe rather than open.

nodes.label: Production-only security hardening
nodes.rationale: SSL redirect, secure cookies and HSTS only when not DEBUG so local HTTP still works; check --deploy clean.

nodes.label: Production-only hashed static storage
nodes.rationale: Manifest storage needs collectstatic, which tests and runserver never run; plain storage used when DEBUG or TESTING.

nodes.label: SECRET_KEY with no default
nodes.rationale: App refuses to start without a key rather than falling back to an insecure one.

nodes.label: Empty state message

nodes.rationale: Site shell with skip link, js class for progressive enhancement of the nav toggle, POST logout form, and IP disclaimer footer.

nodes.label: Card detail My Cards panel
nodes.rationale: Shows add form, existing entry with edit/remove, or login prompt depending on auth and ownership state.

nodes.label: Card detail reviews section
nodes.rationale: Review form hidden once the user has reviewed (one review per user per card); edit/delete only shown to the review author.

nodes.label: card_detail.html
nodes.rationale: Single card page combining card facts, average rating, inline My Cards add/edit panel and inline review form so users can act without leaving the page; login links carry ?next= to return here.

nodes.label: review_form.html
nodes.rationale: One template serves both create and edit, switching copy on whether object exists.

nodes.label: entry_form.html
nodes.rationale: Shared add/edit template; Cancel returns to My Cards when editing, or to the card page when adding.

nodes.label: form_fields.html
nodes.rationale: Generic accessible form renderer: fieldset/legend for radio choices, role=alert non-field errors, help text ids, reused by every form.
